description:
## Summary

- Adds a self-contained interactive architecture explorer at `docs/docs/architecture/explorer.html` with 14 browsable views, wired into MkDocs via `explorer.md` iframe wrapper
- Fixes 6 stale ADR statuses in the ADR index table (`adr/index.md`) to match actual file frontmatter
- All data (component counts, endpoint counts, ADR statuses, dep versions) verified against the codebase

### Views

| # | View | Content |
|---|------|---------|
| 1 | **Overview** | Layered architecture diagram, tech ribbon, stats bar |
| 2 | **Architecture** | 6 SVG diagrams: system context, component model, deployment, security model, federation, data architecture |
| 3 | **Components** | 109 searchable components with detail panels, GitHub links, exports, config vars |
| 4 | **Request Flow** | 3 animated scenarios (tool invoke, OAuth, federation) |
| 5 | **Service Graph** | Force-directed dependency graph with drag/zoom |
| 6 | **Protocols** | 6 transports, 22 MCP methods, 4 higher-level protocols |
| 7 | **Security** | Two-layer model, encryption, validation, HTTP hardening |
| 8 | **Data Layer** | 55 ORM models across 12 groups with GitHub links |
| 9 | **Plugins** | Hooks, transports, execution modes, policy engine |
| 10 | **ADRs** | 50 architecture decisions with status filter and GitHub links |
| 11 | **API Surface** | 142 REST endpoints by router, core routes, MCP endpoints |
| 12 | **Tech Stack** | 8 dependency categories with versions from pyproject.toml |
| 13 | **Config** | 15 categories, ~150 key env vars with defaults and search |
| 14 | **Dev & CI/CD** | 18 GitHub Actions workflows, 12 quality gates, 16-phase release process, 12 test types |

### Key features

- Zero external dependencies (no CDN, no D3, no React) -- pure vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
- All file paths link to `github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge` (opens in new tab)
- Component detail panel with extended descriptions, key exports, related config, clickable dependency navigation
- Particle background animation, smooth view transitions, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+K search, Esc close)
- Dark theme, responsive, print-friendly

## Test plan

- [ ] Open `docs/docs/architecture/explorer.html` directly in a browser -- all 14 views render
- [ ] Run `cd docs && make serve` -- "Interactive Explorer" appears in Design & Roadmap nav section, iframe loads
- [ ] Click component cards -- detail panel slides in with GitHub links, exports, config
- [ ] Architecture tab -- 6 SVG diagrams render with sub-tab navigation
- [ ] ADR cards -- clicking opens the correct ADR file on GitHub
- [ ] Search (Ctrl+K) -- filters components across all categories
- [ ] Service Graph -- nodes are draggable, zoomable, filterable by group

commits.message:
docs: add interactive browsable architecture explorer

Self-contained HTML/CSS/JS single-page app with 7 views:
- Overview with animated layered architecture diagram
- Component Explorer with search/filter across 109 components
- Request Flow with 3 animated scenarios (tool invoke, auth, federation)
- Force-directed service dependency graph with drag/zoom
- Security architecture (two-layer model)
- Data layer (55 ORM models across 12 groups)
- Plugin architecture (hooks, transports, execution modes)

All component counts validated against the codebase. Wired into
MkDocs via explorer.md wrapper with iframe embed.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
docs: add Configuration reference view to architecture explorer

New "Config" tab with 15 categories covering ~150 key environment
variables from .env.example and config.py:

- Required (First-Run): secrets and admin credentials
- Core Application: host, port, environment
- Database: SQLAlchemy connection, pooling
- Redis & Caching: connection, TTL tuning per cache layer
- Authentication: JWT, Basic Auth, email auth, token policy
- SSO Providers: 8 supported IdPs (GitHub, Google, Keycloak, etc.)
- RBAC & Teams: multi-tenant team management
- Feature Flags: UI, A2A, plugins, gRPC, catalog, etc.
- Security Hardening: SSRF, CORS, headers, content validation
- MCP Session Pool: connection pooling with circuit breaker
- Logging: levels, formats, structured and security logging
- Observability & Metrics: OTEL, Prometheus, metrics pipeline
- HTTP Client & Resilience: connection pool, timeouts, retries
- Compression: Brotli/Zstd/GZip settings
- Deployment & Runtime: HTTP server, workers, dev mode

Each category is collapsible. Search filters variables across all
categories and auto-expands matching sections. Variables show name,
default value, and description in a three-column grid.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
docs: add Development & CI/CD view to architecture explorer

New "Dev & CI/CD" tab with 5 sections:

CI/CD Pipeline:
  Visual 6-stage pipeline flow (Commit -> PR/Push -> Build -> Test ->
  Security -> Release) with key actions per stage.

GitHub Actions Workflows (18):
  Cards for every workflow with filename, description, and trigger
  badges (push/PR/release/cron/manual). Covers: lint, pytest, Docker
  multiplatform, Helm publish, Playwright, Vitest, Rust CI, Alembic
  validation, dependency review, security scanning, s390x wheels.

Code Quality Gates (12):
  Black, Ruff, isort, mypy (strict), Pylint, Bandit, Interrogate
  (100% docstring), Coverage (90%), detect-secrets, ESLint, HTMLHint,
  Stylelint -- each with threshold/config.

Release Process (16 phases):
  Full release checklist from version bump through post-release, based
  on docs/docs/development/release-management.md.

Testing Matrix (12 types):
  Unit, integration, E2E, Playwright, Vitest, MCP compliance, DB
  performance, load (JMeter/Locust), security, fuzz, doctest,
  migration -- with Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 coverage.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
docs: add Architecture diagrams view with 6 programmatic SVG diagrams

New "Architecture" tab (2nd position after Overview) with 6 sub-tabbed
SVG diagrams rendered programmatically -- no external images or assets:

1. System Context: ContextForge and external actors (MCP clients,
   browsers, A2A agents, REST/gRPC consumers, IdPs, observability
   backends, MCP servers, databases, Redis, peer gateways)

2. Component Model: 6-layer internal architecture (transport,
   middleware, router, service, cache, data) with plugin framework
   sidebar showing hook integration points

3. Deployment Architecture: Kubernetes production topology with
   nginx ingress, ContextForge pods, optional Rust sidecar,
   PostgreSQL with PgBouncer, Redis, MinIO, Prometheus/Grafana

4. Security Model: Two-layer visualization -- Layer 1 (Token Scoping)
   with API/session token paths and fail-closed defaults, Layer 2
   (RBAC) with 4 built-in roles and permission audit

5. Federation Topology: Multi-gateway peer discovery, cross-gateway
   tool resolution, registry cache sync, and transparent proxy calls

6. Data Architecture: Three-tier data flow -- L1 in-memory caches
   (6 types), L2 Redis layer (5 stores), L3 database (44 tables
   across 6 groups) with Alembic migrations

All diagrams use a consistent dark theme with color-coded elements
matching the explorer's palette. Sub-navigation tabs switch between
diagrams with smooth transitions.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
